steps.en: Install the package into your Python pipeline
steps.zh: 把包装进你的 Python 管线

steps.en: Point it at the 剪映 draft folder on the machine that will open the project
steps.zh: 把它指向将来打开这个工程的机器上的剪映草稿目录

steps.en: Create the draft, describe tracks, segments, text, effects and transitions, then save
steps.zh: 创建草稿，用代码描述轨道、片段、文字、特效与转场，然后保存

steps.en: Fills its bundled templates and writes draft_content.json and draft_meta_info.json into the folder
steps.zh: 用内置模板填好字段，写出这个草稿的 JSON 文件

steps.en: Open 剪映 and pick the draft (refresh the list if it has not appeared)
steps.zh: 打开剪映，找到那个草稿（没出现就先刷新列表）

steps.en: On Windows with 剪映 6 or older, ask it to export through the editor's own controls
steps.zh: 在装有剪映 6 及更早版本的 Windows 上，让它通过编辑器自己的控件导出
steps.code: ctrl.export_draft("要导出的草稿名称", "<导出路径>")

steps.en: Moves the cursor, clicks the editor's export UI, then renames the file into the target path
steps.zh: 移动光标点击编辑器的导出界面，再把渲染好的文件改名到目标路径

value.en: An editable 剪映 draft written from Python — plus an exported MP4 on the legacy Windows setup — with no human building the timeline
value.zh: 用 Python 写出一份可编辑的剪映草稿，在旧的 Windows 组合下还能顺带导出 MP4，不需要人搭时间线

sources: https://github.com/GuanYixuan/pyJianYingDraft README 安装 (pip install pyJianYingDraft, Python 3.8/3.11 推荐, 跨平台兼容性)
README 快速上手 / 用法文档 (draft.DraftFolder("<剪映草稿文件夹>"), script.save(), 草稿列表需刷新)
README 批量导出草稿 (JianyingController, ctrl.export_draft("要导出的草稿名称", "<导出路径>"), 仅 Windows + 剪映6及以下, uiautomation, 导出结束后重命名)
demo.py (draft.DraftFolder, draft_folder.create_draft("demo", 1920, 1080, allow_replace=True)) 与 requirements.txt (pymediainfo, imageio, uiautomation>=2)
